title: Retire & Rebalance: SKU Transition + Regional Allocation Plan
content:
Executive summary:
We need to retire a tranche of older Ampere/V100 nodes and transition committed spend to mixed-precision 80GB Hopper and 48GB Ada SKUs across regions. This doc is a working plan for: (1) retirement schedule, (2) procurement pipeline adjustments (lead times + staggered orders), (3) regional rebalance to smooth utilization spikes, and (4) risk triggers + playbook for emergency replenishment.

Objectives:
- Reduce per-token cost by moving workloads to 80GB Hopper (where latency-critical) and 48GB Ada for cheaper dense inference.
- Maintain 95th percentile latency SLOs for hosted API and Dedicated customers.
- Avoid single-region depletion: keep 7% global spare capacity and 12% regional hot reserve for APAC.

Key assumptions (FY25 Q1-Q3):
- Average fleet utilization baseline: 68% (Sept baseline), projected burn increases 9% q/q due to new customers.
- Procurement lead times (vendor commitments): Hopper (14–20 weeks), Ada (8–12 weeks), Refurbished Ampere/V100 (6–10 weeks).
- Freight and customs volatility: +2–6 weeks for APAC in worst-case.
- Budgeted capital commit for tranche: $8.2M for Q1–Q3 replacements.

Current snapshot (as-of 2024-10-01):
SKU,Count,Region allocation,Avg utilization (%),Unit acquisition cost($k),Vendor lead time (weeks)
V100-32GB,480,US-EAST:240|US-WEST:120|EU-WEST:80|APAC:40,72,10.2,6-10
A100-80GB,640,US-EAST:300|US-WEST:150|EU-WEST:120|APAC:70,66,28.5,10-14
H100-80GB,120,US-EAST:60|EU-WEST:40|APAC:20,64,50.0,14-20
Ada-48GB,0,---,n/a,18.0,8-12

Planned procurement pipeline (proposed):
- Q1 orders (commit by 2024-11-30): 200 Ada-48 -> stagger shipments: 80 to US-EAST (ETA 10w), 60 to EU-WEST (ETA 12w), 60 to APAC (ETA 14w). Purpose: relief for high-cost A100 delta and enable quantized 4-bit runs. Owner: Diego.
- Q2 orders (commit by 2025-01-15): 180 H100 replacements for oldest A100 racks (rollout early Q2). Ship by vendor tranche A/B to avoid single-batch customs delays. Owner: Michael.
- Ongoing spot/short-lead buys: keep a standing PO for 50 refurbished Ampere units (6–8w) for emergency burst. Owner: Priya.

Transition & retirement schedule (draft):
- Nov–Dec 2024: mark 200 V100 racks for decommission, migrate critical KV-cache workloads off these racks.
- Jan–Mar 2025: decommission V100 in waves (50/week) and redeploy Ada/H100 capacity to target regions.
- Mar–Jun 2025: validation window (performance regressions, eval sets); hold 3% global buffer for rollback.

Regional rebalance heuristics:
- Goal: keep per-region spare >=7% and hot-reserve >=12% for APAC until H100 capacity builds.
- Prefer shipping Ada to APAC and EU-WEST first (better price/perf for quantized workloads).
- If APAC lead times exceed 16 weeks, re-route 20% of planned APAC Ada to US-EAST and enable cross-region routing for latency-sensitive prefixes.

SKU mix target (end of Q2 2025):
- H100-80GB: 28% of fleet (latency-critical hosted tiers)
- A100-80GB: 34% (balanced workloads)
- Ada-48GB: 22% (cost-effective dense inference + offline batch)
- V100/refurbished: 16% (legacy + transitional, scheduled retire)

Cost and utilization model (notes):
- Simple unit-cost model used to evaluate mixes: effective cost-per-token approximations in linked spreadsheet (see INFRA-5789).
- Expected unit-cost drop: migrating 30% of token volume from A100 to Ada quantized path reduces costs by ~18% (conservative).

Risks & mitigations:
- Vendor lead-time shock (risk): If H100 lead > 22 weeks, escalate to procurement to increase priority tranche or accept temporary cross-region overprovisioning.
- Customs hold in APAC: shift 30% of planned APAC shipments to EU-WEST then use backbone replication for initial traffic.
- Performance regression after quantized rollout: hold 6-week canary per route; automated rollback with retained V100 pool (3%).

Decision triggers (automated + manual):
- Automated: regional spare <7% for 3 consecutive days -> trigger emergency refurbished buy PR (Priya).
- Manual: observed 95th latency SLO breach > 2% for 48 hours -> convene ops + infra war room and postpone decomm schedule for that region.
- Budget exceeded by >8% on committed PO -> require CFO pre-approval and slow tranche shipments.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Finalize exact Ada density (48 vs 40GB) with bench team — QA needed on tokenization edge cases (Diego).
- Confirm freight insurance increment for APAC (procurement).
- Update rollout runbooks to include KV-cache warmup steps and traffic mirroring checklist (SRE + Solutions Eng).

Action items (owners):
- Diego: finalize Ada initial order spec and submit PO by 2024-11-20.
- Michael: prepare H100 vendor tranche negotiation playbook and alternative vendor list by 2024-12-05.
- Priya: standing PO for 50 refurbished Ampere / V100 units and define acceptance test by 2024-11-15.
- Aisha: coordinate regional routing policy update (console) and rollout canary flags; attach route-level evals.

Appendix: quick table of lead-time contingencies
Scenario,Action,Backup
H100 delayed >22w,Split tranche; flow some load to A100 + increase refurbished buys,Raise canary hold to 8 weeks
APAC customs +4w,Reroute 30% -> EU-WEST; increase hot-reserve in US-EAST,Activate cross-region routing policy
Demand spike >15% q/q,Throttle low-priority offline jobs; apply cost-based routing to Ada pool,Open urgent PO for refurbished 100 units

Notes: draft — expect edits after procurement sync on 2024-11-06 and benching results for Ada quantization by 2024-11-14. This file is a working sheet; use linked tickets for tracker.
